answer: For tasks such as an atlas update, reef survey or terrace design, require a buyer-funded fee held in escrow. Burn more of that fee than the maximum protocol subsidy before releasing rewards. A buyer and worker controlled by one attacker can recycle the remaining payment, but each fake job still destroys more value than its subsidy yields. More identities cannot reverse that loss. Legitimate buyers also pay this cost, so use small subsidies and disclose the burn rate.
